_comment: Amazon links shown beside tracker items. Links only: the hourly checker never fetches Amazon. Each ASIN was checked (opened on amazon.com, or for entries with 'verified_via', read from the Amazon listing through web search) and its title, color, size and ruling matched to the tracked product on the 'verified' date. build_site.py adds the Associates tag. Tracked products with no verified match fall back to their brand link. 'listings' maps a tracked store listing URL (for items without a canonical product id) to its verified Amazon ASIN. Dot grid brands (Archer and Olive, Leuchtturm1917, Scribbles That Matter, Notebook Therapy) get exact listing matches only, never a brand fallback.
